confidence_notes: Coffee, inexpensive-meal and mid-range-meal anchors rest on several 2026-dated aggregated cost-of-living sources (Numbeo, Wise, livingcost, citycost, world-prices) that broadly agree; some index entries are self-reported and may be dated. Beer sits slightly above the index draught figures of about 2.00 to reflect restaurant pricing. The mid-range figure is for two people without drinks; a suggested service charge of about 10% may be added at some venues. Cocktail and wine-glass anchors are less certain, drawing on travel-guide ranges and a few venue reviews rather than aggregated indices; they were sanity-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.8 times beer, wine glass about 2.2 times). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no booking pages, live listings or accommodation searches were used. Ecuador uses the US dollar, so local prices are quoted in USD directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was needed for food and drink, which uses Cuenca-specific aggregated indices and travel guides. Accommodation tiers are model estimates for Cuenca's central tourist market, benchmarked loosely to mid-sized Ecuadorian highland tourist cities from general knowledge.
